reference: Five encoded RHS arrays represent the same 512 nonzero F32 values. Original GGML set_i32/get_f32 establish the I8, I16 and I32 arrays. Berkeley SoftFloat i64_to_f32 and f64_to_f32 establish the I64 and F64 arrays, including a fractional residual in each F64 input. Reverse the two original rows before arithmetic. Evaluate each of 29 decoded left inputs and four arithmetic operators once on the generic GGML CPU. Reuse its 116 results across the five RHS formats and all legal destinations. GGML type traits, quantizers, get_i32/set_i32 and SoftFloat f32_to_i64_r_minMag or f32_to_f64 supply the destination bytes.
